KEEP THE BODY SHORT. Four lines is the target, ten is the ceiling.
If it needs more than that, the reasoning belongs in docs/ and this issue
links to it. A long issue is one nobody reads.

Label with exactly two: one severity (sev:high / sev:medium / sev:low) and one
topic (ranking, data, catalog, web, eval, tooling, docs).

This repo is public: no personal data, secrets, or where secrets are kept.

**Symptom** — what is wrong when you run it, in one line.

**Where** — `path/to/file.go:123`

**Why it matters** — the consequence, not the mechanism. One or two lines.

**Fix direction** — the shape of the fix, or `unknown`. One or two lines.
